frase_gancho.texto: Thirteen altars, a sacred mountain, and the most beautiful palace in the city.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: At the northern end, the Avenue opens onto a monumental setting. The Plaza of the Moon gathers thirteen altars and ancient ritual canals, while at the far end the Pyramid of the Moon echoes the silhouette of Cerro Gordo and hides within it six other buildings consecrated with sacrifices. In the southwest corner of the plaza, you can enter the Palace of Quetzalpapálotl, with its pillars carved with quetzal-butterflies, walk through the porticoes of the Palace of the Jaguars, and peer into the underground temple of the Feathered Conches.
